# LokTube 1.6.3

- **Native Google Cast:** Discover compatible Cast receivers on the local network, including Google Nest Hub, Chromecast/Google TV, and a Pixel Tablet in its Charging Speaker Dock with Cast reception enabled. Use **Cast → Refresh** to scan again.
- **YouTube playback handoff:** Launch the receiver's YouTube app over Cast V2 and transfer the current YouTube video, playback position and bounded queue without exposing local stream URLs or Google account cookies.
- **Receiver controls:** Pause/resume, stop, seek and adjust receiver volume from LokTube. A disconnected receiver offers a reconnection action.
- **TV-code fallback:** Keep the previous YouTube **Link with TV code** option for supported devices not discovered on the local network.
- **Compatibility work:** Handle classic Chromecast/Nest and Android TV YouTube receiver launches, multicast and unicast mDNS discovery, Cast V2 heartbeat, and bounded protocol parsing. Add unit and desktop integration coverage.

**Requirements and limitations:** The computer and receiver must share a reachable local network that allows mDNS discovery. Pixel Tablet generally needs to be docked for Cast reception. Casting sends playback to the receiver's YouTube app; it does not mirror the desktop. Receiver compatibility may vary because the YouTube TV/MDX control protocol is undocumented. Real-world casting on a Nest Hub and docked Pixel Tablet has **not yet been verified**; passing automated CI is not device certification.

Implemented in [PR #25](https://github.com/lokal-music/loktube/pull/25).
